TameInterpolationProducts.hasInterpolation_mul_local_growth_common:
theorem hasInterpolation_mul_local_growth_common_base
    (p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E) (q : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ F)
    (hp : Monotone p) (hq : Monotone q)
    (hIp : HasInterpolation p) (hIq : HasInterpolation q)
    (requestedBase : ℕ) :
    ∃ base : ℕ, requestedBase ≤ base ∧ ∀ offset : ℕ, ∃ loss : ℕ,
      ∀ Kp Kq : ℝ, 0 ≤ Kp → 0 ≤ Kq →
      ∀ s : ℕ, base ≤ s → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
        ∀ a b : ℕ, a + b ≤ s + offset → ∀ x y,
          p base x ≤ Kp → q base y ≤ Kq →
          p a x * q b y ≤ C * (1 + p (s + loss) x + q (s + loss) y)

LocalizedJetInterpolation.hasInterpolation_localized_slot_growth_c:
theorem hasInterpolation_localized_slot_growth_common_base
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E) (hp : Monotone p) (hI : HasInterpolation p)
    (oldBase extra : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, oldBase ≤ B ∧ ∀ oldLoss : ℕ, ∃ L : ℕ,
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K →
      ∀ s : ℕ, B ≤ s → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ b c : ℕ, b + c ≤ s → ∀ (x : E) (v : Fin n → E) (w : E),
        p B x ≤ K → (∀ i, p B (v i) ≤ 1) → p B w ≤ 1 →
        ((1 + p (b + oldLoss) x + ∑ i : Fin n, p (b + oldLoss) (v i)) *
          p (oldBase + c + extra) w + p (b + oldLoss + c + extra) w) ≤
        C * (1 + p (s + L) x + ∑ i : Fin n, p (s + L) (v i) + p (s + L) w)
LocalizedJetInterpolation.hasInterpolation_quadratic_local_growth_:
theorem hasInterpolation_quadratic_local_growth_common_base
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E) (hp : Monotone p) (hI : HasInterpolation p)
    (oldBase extra : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, oldBase ≤ B ∧ ∀ oldLoss : ℕ, ∃ L : ℕ,
      ∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R →
      ∀ s : ℕ, B ≤ s → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ b c : ℕ, b + c ≤ s → ∀ x : E, p B x ≤ R →
        ((1 + p (b + oldLoss) x) * (1 + p (oldBase + c + extra) x) +
          (1 + p (b + oldLoss + c + extra) x)) ≤ C * (1 + p (s + L) x)

N01EndpointOneHigh.N01Properties.endpointFlowScalarJets_pos:
theorem N01Properties.endpointFlowScalarJets_positive_circleNorm_oneHigh_uniform_radius
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, base ≤ B ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R →
      ∀ s : ℕ, B ≤ s → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ (rsel : ℕ → ℝ) (hrsel : ∀ m, rsel m ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)),
      ∀ z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε,
      pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading B z ≤ R →
      ∀ v : Fin (n + 1) → (StateDirections S × ℝ),
      circleNorm T (3 / 4 : ℝ) s
        (hN.endpointFlowScalarJets hS hT rsel hrsel (n + 1) z v) ≤
        K * oneHighVariationWeight (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
          B (s + L) z v

N01EndpointCircleTower.N01Properties.exists_endpointFlowCircle_:
theorem N01Properties.exists_endpointFlowCircle_smoothDirections
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (rsel : ℕ → ℝ) (hrsel : ∀ m, rsel m ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)) :
    ∃ J : SmoothDirections (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε) (hN.endpointFlowCircle hS hT rsel hrsel),
      ∀ n x, x ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε → ∀ v : Fin n → (StateDirections S × ℝ),
        (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).decode (J.D n x v) = hN.endpointFlowScalarJets hS hT rsel hrsel n x v

N01EndpointZeroGrowth.N01Properties.endpointFlowCircle_circleN:
theorem N01Properties.endpointFlowCircle_circleNorm_local_growth_uniform_radius
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) :
    ∃ B L : ℕ, base ≤ B ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R →
      ∀ s : ℕ, B ≤ s → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ (rsel : ℕ → ℝ) (hrsel : ∀ m, rsel m ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)),
      ∀ x ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε,
      pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading B x ≤ R →
      circleNorm T (3 / 4 : ℝ) s ((S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).decode (hN.endpointFlowCircle hS hT rsel hrsel x)) ≤
        K * (1 + pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading (s + L) x)

N01FlowCircleUniformBounds.N01Properties.endpointFlowCircle_uniform:
theorem N01Properties.endpointFlowCircle_uniformFamilyJetBounds
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (rsel : I → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hrsel : ∀ i m, rsel i m ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m))
    (J : ∀ i, SmoothDirections (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε)
      (hN.endpointFlowCircle hS hT (rsel i) (hrsel i))) :
    UniformFamilyJetBounds (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
      (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).grading J
